name: Very Scary Gays
source:
Welcome to Your Best Nightmare!
Unsure of where to start with your brand new college degree? Are the bears in your life already taken and/or not ghoulish enough? Yearning for the exhilaration of possible demise in your dating life? This queer dating sim can help! From the soft himbos to the party hoes, all of these human-ish men are ready to start a new life with you. This campy dating simulator is about helping your partner achieve his dreams and nearly getting arrested, injured, or killed in the process.

[From [url=https://goosequail.itch.io/very-scary-gays]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到你最好的噩梦！
不确定从哪里开始你的全新大学学位？你生活中的熊是否已经被抓走和/或还不够残忍？渴望约会生活中可能死亡的兴奋吗？这款酷儿约会模拟游戏可以帮上忙！从温柔的男人到派对锄头，所有这些人性化的男人都准备好与你开始新的生活。这款做作的约会模拟器旨在帮助你的伴侣实现他的梦想，并在此过程中差点被捕、受伤或死亡。

[来自[url=https://goosequail.itch.io/very-scary-gays]Itch.io[/url]]
